Type: dark wall shelf with metal brackets
Use: displaying books and decor; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: black-brown wood-effect particleboard shelf, brushed aluminium brackets
Colors: dark black-brown, silver grey

Goes with: white or grey walls, chrome or steel accents, dark wood furniture; modern, minimalist or contemporary rooms
